ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "UP", model: p('openai.model'), openaiConfigured: not isEmpty(p('openai.apiKey')), agentPath: p('agent.path') }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- ((payload.message.parts default []) filter ($.text != null) map $.text) joinBy "\n"
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- lower((payload.message.metadata.demo_mode default "normal") as String)
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (lower((payload.message.metadata.answer_source default "scripted") as String) == "model") "model" else "scripted"
%dw 2.0 import * from dw::demo_modes output application/java --- if (isKnown(vars.mode)) scripted(vars.mode) else "Unknown demo mode '" ++ vars.mode ++ "'."

set-variable.doc:name: Key not configured
set-variable.value: Real-model answers need the openai.apiKey secure property. Pick a scripted mode, or set the key in Runtime Manager.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import * from dw::demo_modes output application/json --- modelRequest(p('openai.model'), vars.mode, vars.question)
